## Checklist

Please ensure all items are checked before requesting a review:

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (PEP 8, Black, isort)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My code passes all linting checks (`make lint`)
- [ ] My code passes type checking (`make type-check`)
- [ ] My code passes security scanning (`make security`)

### Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`make test`)
- [ ] Test coverage has been maintained or improved
- [ ] I have tested on multiple Python versions (if applicable)

### Documentation
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] I have updated the README.md (if needed)
- [ ] I have updated CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased" section
- [ ] I have added docstrings to new functions/classes
- [ ] I have updated API documentation (if applicable)

### Git
- [ ] My commits follow the Conventional Commits specification
- [ ] I have rebased my branch on the latest main/develop
- [ ] I have resolved all merge conflicts
- [ ] My branch has a clear, descriptive name

### Dependencies
- [ ] I have updated requirements.txt (if I added dependencies)
- [ ] I have verified all dependencies are necessary
- [ ] I have checked for security vulnerabilities in new dependencies
